Itineraries

A Jaisalmer itinerary for couples

Build a two-day trip around the haveli lanes, sunset views and time together in the desert.

Open the trip planner ↗

Day 1 — The city at your pace

Morning

Jaisalmer Fort, unhurried.

Afternoon

Havelis, with time for photographs.

Evening

Suli Dungari for best Sunset with full Golden Fort Image and peace

Day 2 — Desert evening

Morning

Gadisar Lake with a short boat ride.

Afternoon

Kuldhara for a quiet, atmospheric stop.

Evening

Sam Dunes sunset, with an overnight desert camp for stargazing.
